title: Guided Schema Cheatstrip: compact onboarding assets and validation quickfix UI
creator: Ava Chen
description: Design a compact "cheatstrip" UI and supporting visual assets for the Structured Output Quickstart. The cheatstrip is a slim, dismissible overlay that sits above the console editor and provides three rapid actions: generate example payloads, run schema linting with inline error highlights, and apply suggested quickfixes. Deliverables: Figma frames (desktop + mobile), animated GIFs for the onboarding tour, 3 annotated screenshot exports for release notes, copy snippets for microcopy and accessibility, and a small icon set for status states (OK, warning, error).
acceptance_criteria: Figma file with annotated frames for desktop editor overlay, mobile condensed view, and example-card gallery
Three exported PNG screenshots sized for release notes (1200x630) showing: (1) cheatstrip collapsed, (2) cheatstrip expanded with generated example, (3) inline lint error with quickfix applied
Animated GIF (max 8s) demonstrating: open cheatstrip -> generate example -> apply quickfix -> success badge
Copy for microcopy and tooltip text reviewed by content and accessibility check passed
Design handoff package uploaded to Drive with redlines, icon exports (SVG), and a short design spec doc linking to the Console PR
tasks: Draft initial concept wireframes for cheatstrip and example-cards
Design desktop overlay + responsive mobile variant in Figma
Create three example payloads for sample models (chat, completions, embeddings) to display in cards
Design inline lint highlight styles and quickfix microinteraction
Produce animated GIF walkthough and 3 static screenshots
Write microcopy candidate set and run two review passes with content and accessibility
Export assets (SVG icons, PNG/WEBP screenshots, GIF) and attach to handoff folder
Prepare a one-page handoff with developer notes and CSS tokens for the Console team
designer_notes: Primary goal: reduce friction for first-run structured output users by surfacing concrete example payloads and fast repair flows. Keep the overlay < 64px height when collapsed and make transitions 160-220ms for perceived snappiness. Use existing Console color tokens for warnings and errors. For accessibility, ensure that the cheatstrip can be keyboard-focused and dismissed with ESC. GIF should be 2-3 loops max and optimized for size. Coordinate with Console engineers on class names for '.cheatstrip' and '.schema-lint' to avoid refactor churn.

decisions: Use a slim horizontal 'cheatstrip' instead of a full side panel to minimize context switching
Include three prefilled example templates (minimal, typical, strict) instead of generating random examples on first-run
Quickfixes will be non-destructive and presented as one-click suggestions; accept triggers an editor patch event rather than automatic overwrite
Animated GIFs limited to 8s and reduced color depth for file size budget
